'''Kimber stones''' were [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] produced by [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Y'ness/Legends|Y'ness]]. They were once considered unsuitable for use in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] because they produced a non-[[Death/Legends|lethal]] blade. However, certain [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] believed the stones had potential, leading to a number of them being removed from Y'ness before the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] destruction. By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], these crystals were sold as simple trinkets on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] by individuals who did not understand their true nature and value.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
